asthma.description: A long-term condition where the airways narrow and swell, causing wheezing, cough and breathlessness.
precautions: Avoid triggers such as smoke, dust and cold air
Keep your prescribed inhaler with you
Get a lung function test
Seek emergency care for severe breathlessness

appendicitis.description: Inflammation of the appendix, usually causing pain that starts near the navel and moves to the lower right abdomen.
precautions: Do not eat or drink heavily until a doctor checks you
Avoid pain medicine that could hide symptoms
Go to emergency care quickly, it can be urgent

angina.description: Chest pain or pressure caused by reduced blood flow to the heart.
precautions: Stop and rest when the pain starts
Do not ignore chest pain, get it checked urgently
Call emergency services if pain lasts more than a few minutes

allergy.description: An immune reaction to something harmless such as pollen, dust, food or medicine.
precautions: Avoid the trigger if you know it
Antihistamines may help, ask a pharmacist or doctor
Get emergency help for swelling of the face or trouble breathing

acute sinusitis.description: Inflammation of the sinuses, often after a cold, causing facial pressure, congestion and headache.
precautions: Rest and drink fluids
Use steam or saline nasal rinses
See a doctor if it lasts more than 10 days or you have high fever

panic disorder.description: Repeated sudden episodes of intense fear with racing heart, breathlessness and dizziness.
precautions: Slow your breathing during an episode
Reduce caffeine and alcohol
Talk to a doctor or counsellor about treatment
Get emergency help if chest pain is new or severe

pneumonia.description: An infection that inflames the air sacs in the lungs, causing cough, fever and breathlessness.
precautions: See a doctor soon for a chest examination
Rest and drink fluids
Take prescribed antibiotics fully
Go to emergency care if breathing is hard

infectious gastroenteritis.description: A stomach and bowel infection causing diarrhea, vomiting and cramps.
precautions: Drink oral rehydration solution
Eat light food
Wash hands often
See a doctor if there is blood in stool or you cannot keep fluids down

hypoglycemia.description: Low blood sugar, causing shakiness, sweating, hunger and confusion.
precautions: Take fast sugar such as juice or glucose if you are able to swallow
Recheck after 15 minutes
Get urgent help if confused or unconscious

concussion.description: A mild brain injury after a blow to the head, causing headache, dizziness and confusion.
precautions: Rest and avoid screens and sports
Do not drive until cleared
Get urgent care for repeated vomiting, drowsiness or worsening headache

acute bronchitis.description: Inflammation of the airways causing cough, often with mucus, usually after a viral infection.
precautions: Rest and drink fluids
Avoid smoke
See a doctor if cough lasts over 3 weeks or you have trouble breathing

carpal tunnel syndrome.description: Pressure on a nerve in the wrist causing numbness, tingling and pain in the hand.
precautions: Rest the wrist and avoid repetitive strain
Use a wrist splint at night
See a doctor if numbness persists
